Both legs of the gating rule (`bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test`) pass. Run fresh this session.

### Conformance Probes

I executed the probe implementations directly out of `/Users/ns/workspace/dev-process-toolkit/plugins/dev-process-toolkit/adapters/_shared/src/` against this project root rather than eyeballing them, so these are real return values. **Four error-severity probes fired. All four on the same file — `specs/frs/CJ6KFN.md`.**

**#13 `identity_mode_conditional`** — `specs/frs/CJ6KFN.md:8` — expected `tracker:` absent, actual `tracker: { ... }`
> Remedy: delete the `tracker:` line from frontmatter — mode-none FRs identify themselves via the short-ULID `id:` line, not a tracker binding.

> Remedy: `specs/*` ⇒ `/spec-write` Step 7a.

**#67 `fr_summary_altitude`** — `specs/frs/CJ6KFN.md:16` — rule `backtick`: the `## Summary` body carries inline code spans (`` `tracker:` ``, `` `mode: none` ``).

```

- **Spec compliance — OK.** All four ACs have a named, one-per-AC test at `src/greet.test.ts:6,10,14,18`. AC-JQMS6D.4 uses a mixed whitespace run (`"  \t\n  "`), which is what the FR's Testing section specifically asked for over spaces-only. No undocumented production behavior was added.
